tool_args.rationale: The open-branch data contradict a gradient-independent radiation model and align with the documented inland-hub siphon response. Fit its inhibition and square-root branch terms numerically using the full seven-row set. The branch sign is estimated from data rather than fixed. Fresh confirmation previously refuted the polynomial/quartic attempts, not this targeted siphon form.

considered_alternatives.rejected_reason: The verified quartic relation failed fresh confirmation; branch readings vary strongly with s_grad.
Already acquired; added observations establish a broad sink-gradient span.

considered_alternatives.rejected_reason: No temporal variation or evidence identifying a time-dependent state law; simpler static siphon model is directly supported.
Irrelevant to the observed gradient-dependent mechanism and explicitly not worth its cost.
